title: Arrangement Variant Decoder
description: Twelve written fan descriptions, shuffled once per session; for each the learner picks one code from a fixed list of 20 arrangement codes and presses Check (one scored attempt, mastery 10 of 12). An optional feature hint lists drive, impeller, support and motor; Retry missed practises the missed items without scoring.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: arrangement variants
overhung and center hung impellers
direct drive and belt drive
slide base
adjustable motor base
plenum fan
pedestal plug fan
swingout fan
clamshell fan

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Arrangement variant codes: motor location, support and access features
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate twelve arrangement variants by naming the arrangement code that matches a written description of a fan's drive, motor location, support and access features.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); selections, hints and verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗/→ glyphs on the code buttons and solid/dashed feedback borders pair with colour; the answer list is one Tab stop with arrow-key navigation; Enter checks or goes on; H toggles the hint.

controls.label: Answer list (20 codes)
controls.purpose: Select one arrangement code (arrow keys move the selection)

controls.label: Show hint / Hide hint
controls.purpose: Show the description's features by category; never scored (H)

controls.label: Next item / Finish
controls.purpose: Go to the next item; after item 12, show the summary (Enter)

controls.label: Retry missed
controls.purpose: Summary only: practise the missed items, not scored

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Run all twelve items again in the session's order and clear the score

rules: One code per item; exact match with the spec's Correct code column.
Item order is shuffled once per session; Start over keeps that order.
The answer list never changes between items.
One scored attempt per item; hints are not scored; Retry missed rounds are not scored.
Mastery is 10 of 12 correct on the first attempt.
limitations: Descriptions are short summaries; real drawings carry more detail.

sources: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia, pp. 20-28 (arrangement drawings) and pp. 163-173 (technical descriptions)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Differentiate near-identical codes by the one feature that separates them (motor location, support or door type)
keyQuestions: Is the impeller on the motor shaft or on its own fan shaft?
Where is the motor: on the pedestal, on a frame, inside the pedestal, or separate?
What holds the fan up: wall, pedestal at grade, inlet flange?
When the door opens, does the rotor move or only the casing?
commonMisconceptions: Any direct drive fan is Arrangement 4.
The P suffix changes the drive.
Swingout and clamshell are the same construction.
9F is the right fix whenever a large motor needs isolators.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'First-attempt score: n of 12'; mastery is 10 of 12 on the first attempt.
Summary list of missed items with the correct code and the code chosen.
